newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed discontinues adjustment borrowing details.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed discontinues adjustment borrowing details.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said on Thursday that it was discontinuing the release of details on the pattern of weekly adjustment borrowing.
The information was made available to financial news reporters during the weekly Thursday press briefing.
As of Thursday, the New York Fed said the adjustment borrowing details would no longer be available.

The Fed said the discontinuation was based on the Fed's belief that the breakdown was no longer informative about the pattern of reserve supply and demand in the banking sytstem, as there no longer are clear or significant institutional distinctions between the categories.
